picks.headline: Pixel Buds app update lets Gemini control audio and settings
picks.excerpt: We’re now starting to see Gemini audio controls with the latest Pixel Buds companion app update. This is part of...
picks.rationale: Shipping feature: voice-agent control of earbud audio/settings, a concrete shift in hearables interaction; fresh, no prior coverage.

picks.headline: Liminal Uses Meta Glasses To Deliver Meditation Based On What You See
picks.excerpt: Liminal is taking its wellness approach outside the headset. Liminal: Walking Meditation uses Meta AI glasses to create a spoken meditation around what you actually see.
picks.rationale: Novel third-party app using the glasses' camera + AI to generate context-aware audio; shows the emerging glasses app model, distinct from prior Meta Muse/hearing cards.

picks.headline: [써보고서] '스냅드래곤 AI' 입은 AR글래스...공간컴퓨팅·영화 속 장면 눈앞
picks.excerpt: [마우이(미국)=지디넷코리아 전화평 기자] 이건 물병입니다.안경을 쓴 채 눈앞의 사물을 바라보며 이게 뭐야?라고 묻자 귓가에서 즉각 답변이 나왔다. 미국 인공지능(AI) 스타트업 프리즘ML(Prism ML)이 선보인 스마트글래스가 내놓은 대답이다. 놀라운 점은 이 모든 과정이 인터넷...
picks.rationale: Hands-on of fully offline, on-device visual AI in AR glasses (PrismML on Snapdragon); new capability, Korean-outlet diversity, distinct from the 07-17 Bonsai model story.

picks.headline: Early AMD 'Gorgon Halo' AI mini-PC packs 192GB RAM for an eye-watering $7,099
picks.excerpt: A pocket-size powerhouse with a giganormous price tag
picks.rationale: First Gorgon Halo (Ryzen AI Max Pro 495) local-AI mini-PC with price point; new-gen hardware for running models locally, not a repeat of earlier Strix Halo boxes.

picks.headline: When Can We Exit the AI Toothbrush Era?
picks.excerpt: AI toothbrushes are an entire market now. Which leaves me wondering: why?
picks.rationale: Critical take on AI-washing in consumer hardware; useful counterweight for product designers, fifth distinct outlet.
